title: Organization
description: The company itself: what it is legally, and where and when it began. Named after schema.org's Organization.

legal_name.description: The registered name, e.g. Acme Widgets, LLC.

entity_type.description: The kind of legal entity, e.g. LLC, C corporation, GmbH.

jurisdiction.description: Where it is registered, e.g. Delaware, United States.

tax_id.description: Its tax identifier (e.g. a US EIN). Not a secret: it appears on invoices and tax forms.

headquarters.description: Where it's based: a city and country.
